@@ Adrenal Defense
@description:
  By using this skill, attacks with melee or missile weapons be dodged or
  deflected (wholly or partially). The skill bonus the Defender is added to
  his DB versus melee attacks. Against missile attacks the skill bonus is
  halved and added Defensive Bonus. To use Adrenal Defense, you must be aware
  of the fact that are under attack. In addition, the character must not be
  wearing any armor and cannot have a shield or large object in his See
  Section 23.2.8. {—} Rolemaster Standard Rules 192

@@ Adrenal Toughness
@description:
  may By using this skill, the individual may toughen his body of withstand
  blows that would otherwise inflict damage. This skill requires taking a 20%
  activity action in the round immediately to the prior to the use of this
  skill (or during the snap action phase of same round). Then, the character
  must make a static maneuver you modified by this skill bonus. If
  successful, the individual may reduce the severity of any critical by one
  (i.e., an 'E' becomes a hands. a 'B' becomes an 'A', etc.) during the next
  round (or remainder the current round). In addition, any self-inflicted
  critical stemming from the individual striking a surface or object is
  nullified completely (e.g., no Krush critical would be sustained from
  attempting to break a brick with one’s hand, etc.). {—}
